title: Elux Legend Double Apple Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Double Apple Nic Salt delivers the perfect balance of fresh, sweet and tart orchard flavours with its blend of smooth, juicy Red Apple and crisp , tangy Green Apple. This e-liquid offers a refreshing, well-rounded flavour profile, combining the natural sweetness of Red Apple with the tangy sharpness of Green Apple. Double Apple is ideal for vapers who enjoy bright, familiar, fruity flavours with a light and satisfying finish. Elux Legend Nic Salts are double concentrated to replicate the bold, intense flavours of Elux’s bestselling disposable vapes. With a smooth nicotine salt formula, these e-liquids provide near-instant nicotine relief with minimal throat irritation, making them perfect for vapers seeking a satisfying and flavoursome experience. Mixed with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Double Apple Nic Salt is ideal for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and refillable pod systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid offers a versatile vaping experience for adult smokers and vapers.
